statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The denial reason was that the service was not deemed medically necessary under current Federal Medicare guidelines
Mobile cardiac telemetry is clinically indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
